title: WhatsApp reminder (tap-to-send)
description: Button on an unpaid/partial invoice opens WhatsApp via a wa.me deep link with a pre-filled reminder message; warden taps send.
acceptanceCriteria: Tapping the reminder opens WhatsApp with tenant's number and a pre-filled message
Message includes tenant name, amount due, and due date
No auto-send occurs without the warden's explicit tap

history.note: Ticket created from initial DESIGN.md feature breakdown.

Building alongside LODGY-19 - one ReminderScreen with a channel toggle (WhatsApp/SMS), matching the wireframe. Message language (Hindi/English) is specific to this feature per DESIGN.md 4.9 ('reminder templates also available in Hindi and English... warden can pick per-reminder'), independent of LODGY-30's app-wide language switcher, so writing both message templates directly here rather than waiting on that ticket.

Built contact/ReminderIntents.kt (whatsApp: wa.me/<digits>?text=<url-encoded>, sms: smsto: + sms_body extra) and contact/ReminderMessageBuilder.kt (Hindi/English templates, date formatted via the target locale so month names come out right in either language). ReminderViewModel resolves the full chain from invoiceId (invoice -> agreement -> tenant for name/phone, agreement -> bed -> room -> floor -> hostel for the hostel-name signature) and rebuilds the message live when the language toggle changes. ReminderScreen shows channel + language chips, a live preview, and one send button that launches the right intent via runCatching (wrapped like LODGY-31, same crash-safety reasoning). Wired a Reminder button next to Record on every unpaid/partial InvoiceListScreen row. `gradlew assembleDebug` -> BUILD SUCCESSFUL, no warnings. AC3 (no auto-send) holds by construction - both intents only ever open the target app pre-filled, tapping send there is entirely the warden's action. On-device pass still queued.
